theme: Luxurious Dark & Light Adaptive (Default: Deep Midnight Slate #0F172A with Champagne Gold #D4AF37 & Royal Emerald #10B981 accents)
persona: E1 Anti-AI Designer - High-Density Precision Luxury
design_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Swiss grid structure meets high-end luxury hospitality aesthetics (Champagne Gold, Rich Slate, Velvet Crimson accent touches).
Emotion First: High-status operational authority. Every metric and booking block feels tactile and commanding.
Content is King: Dynamic real-time timeline, instant visual conflict warnings, clear INR (₹) financial breakdowns, high-density data matrices.
Contrast & Hierarchy: Strict APCA contrast standards, zero muddy text, vivid status tags for instant scanability.

typography.font_pairings: Outfit for strong commanding headers + Plus Jakarta Sans for dense, high-readability table and timeline text
rules: DO NOT use Inter or Arial for Main Headings; use Outfit or Clash Display.
All numeric financial figures (₹) and dates MUST use tabular numbers or JetBrains Mono for exact column alignment.

colors.archetype: LUXURY & PERFORMANCE PRO (Deep Midnight Slate + Champagne Gold + Royal Emerald)

layout_and_spacing.structure: Sidebar + Fixed Top Nav + Main Scrollable Canvas
layout_and_spacing.topnav_height: h-16 flex items-center px-6 justify-between border-b border-border bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-md sticky top-0 z-40
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: MODE B: High Density Grid (12-column layout for analytics and timeline dashboard)
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-lg for buttons & inputs
rules: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text touch.
Ensure space between widgets is consistent (gap-4 or gap-6).
Grid children must be direct children. Avoid nesting motion div directly breaking grid spans.

auth_roles.features: Custom JWT auth simulation, role switcher in topbar, granular permission guards on sensitive actions (e.g., delete booking, override discount, view audit logs).

kpi_cards: Monthly Revenue (₹ INR with growth % badge)
charts: Revenue vs Expense Comparison (Recharts Area/Bar Chart)
Monthly Event Category Breakdown (Wedding, Corporate, Social, Exhibition)

features: Interactive Booking Table with Search, Hall Filter, Date Range, Status Filter, and Pagination
Real-Time Conflict Detection Engine (checks Hall + Booking Date + Event Time Slot overlap)
Conflict Warning Modal & Banner with suggested alternative halls/slots
Booking Status Transition Workflow (Inquiry -> Tentative -> Confirmed -> In Progress -> Completed -> Cancelled)
New Booking Drawer / Dialog with guest count, catering package, decor add-ons, and payment advance calculation

calendar_timeline.features: Drag/click time slot to trigger new booking, color-coded by event status or hall, conflict highlight overlay.

features: Customer Directory with VIP tags, total bookings, total spent (₹ INR)
Detailed Profile View (Contact Info, Event History, Notes, Preferences e.g. Pure Veg, Jain, Non-Veg, DJ License)
Direct CTA: Create Booking for Customer, Send Quote, Generate Statement

banquet_halls.features: Hall CRUD, amenity tags management, hourly/slot rate configuration, active/maintenance toggle.

features: Payment Ledger with Cash, UPI, Bank Transfer, Cheque, Credit Card options
Advance Payment receipt generation with balance due countdown
Payment status badges (Fully Paid, Partial Deposit, Pending, Overdue)
Printable & PDF-exportable GST Invoice
Itemized breakdown (Hall rental, Plate cost x Guests, Service charge, SGST 9%, CGST 9%)
Official Stamp, Signature Line, and Payment Terms block
Category breakdown (Catering Supplies, Floral Decorators, AV & Sound, Electricity/Utility, Staff Payroll)
Vendor tagging, date filter, receipt attachment simulator, impact on net profitability
Comprehensive financial matrix (Total Revenue - Total Expenses = Net Profit)
Hall-wise revenue contribution chart
Export reports as CSV or PDF report format
Notification Center with unread counter, conflict warnings, payment reminders, booking updates
Audit Log Timeline tracking user actions (e.g., 'Manager modified Booking #BMS-104', 'Accountant recorded ₹50,000 payment')
Venue Identity (Name, Logo, GSTIN, Address, Phone)
Tax Rates Configuration (GST 18% default)
Role Permissions Matrix
Email/SMS Notification Templates

motion_and_microinteractions.hover_effects: Subtle border highlight transition, scale-[1.01] lift on cards, smooth background shifts on buttons.
motion_and_microinteractions.transitions: EXPLICIT properties only (e.g. transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease). NEVER use transition: all.
motion_and_microinteractions.toasts: Sonner library toast popups for conflict alerts, booking creations, payment logs, and error notices.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: APCA & WCAG 4.5:1 minimum compliance for all text. No gray-on-gray unreadable labels.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testids: MANDATORY data-testid on all interactive buttons, inputs, navigation items, tables, modal action triggers, and KPI cards.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based. Examples: data-testid="new-booking-button", data-testid="search-input", data-testid="hall-filter-select", data-testid="conflict-warning-alert"

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, production-ready, highly aesthetic SaaS application for GrandImperia Banquet Management System.
Strictly follow the INR (₹) currency formatting for all monetary values.

Implement seed data with 4 roles (Super Admin, Manager, Booking Staff, Accountant), 4 sample halls, 4 packages, multiple realistic bookings with dates across current/upcoming months, payments, expenses, audit logs, and notifications.
Ensure real-time conflict detection triggers whenever user tries to book a hall on an already occupied slot date & time range.
Provide interactive modals/drawers for creating bookings, adding payments, viewing invoices (with print layout), adding expenses, and viewing customer history.
All components MUST include proper data-testid attributes for automated testing.
